condition: fetchWebContent must reject a caller-supplied IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback HTTP URL after WHATWG URL parsing, before its initial outbound request
prerequisites: No-argument MCP server launch with the default full in-process runtime, default fetchWebContent name and no dependency-injected service replacement.
The caller supplies http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/ with valid ordinary options; no operator-configured proxy is selected.
Score the initial literal-address request only; DNS rebinding, redirects, browser/cookie fallback and successful response retrieval are not prerequisites or claims.
flow: src/index.ts creates the SDK server and invokes setupTools. No arguments select createOpenWebSearchRuntime, whose default service binds the web re-export to fetchWebContent. The registered URL passes through validatePublicWebUrl/isPublicHttpUrl at the schema and service, then the same parsed hostname is checked at the request sink. The vulnerable helper sends bracketed literals to isIP unchanged, bypassing its IP branch; the fixed helper strips brackets and rejects non-unicast classification, with an enforced initial check before the checked request helper.
fixed_scope: The fixed source and upstream asserted regression vectors support the narrow initial mapped-loopback label. Broader redirect/DNS/browser changes are retained, not independently validated or scored here.
safe_scope: The fixed upstream URL cases assert acceptance of ordinary public IPv4 http://8.8.8.8/resource; the case concerns the predicate, not actual service availability.
